limits: These are live faults on one dedicated disposable enrolled rootless worker, not full native fault or production acceptance.
A preflight inspected the wrong mount namespace and stopped before fault injection. It was corrected to inspect the exact supervisor process namespace.
Two preflight scans encountered an absent broker and retained partial coverage. The existing broker and credentials were restored before the retained real-model baseline and live faults.
The baseline harness initially asserted the wrong terminal-state spelling; its already-retained completed result was checked without repeating that scan.
The failed container-loss scan started before the real-model baseline. Preservation of three existing candidates is established by the later supervisor-loss case.
The supervisor-loss operation remains unknown and owned even after container disappearance; no lease was cleared and no operation was redispatched.
Full dispatch/persistence-cut coverage and separately authorized recovery remain pending.
